fields.name: charsGroupPath
fields.description: Record of the group path createFromScenes persisted the book's charPerson records into (for PB2 books, the world population group olio.world population.path, NOT the legacy {bookGroupPath}/Characters sub-group which is created but left empty). SECURITY: this note lives in a user-owned data.note and is therefore attacker-writable, so listCharacters MUST NOT feed it to any query. listCharacters re-derives the group server-side from the book's own world anchor and uses this stored value ONLY for a tamper-warning log comparison. Do not re-wire read paths to trust this field — doing so reintroduces a same-org horizontal IDOR (see TestPictureBookListCharactersIdor).

fields.name: failedCharacters
fields.description: Names of characters whose createCharPerson() failed during extraction — a 200 response never silently implies 0 failures.

fields.name: failedApparel
fields.description: Names of characters whose best-effort apparel-wizard step failed during createCharPerson() — the character itself was still created; only apparel is missing.

fields.name: failedStatistics
fields.description: Names of characters whose best-effort statistics-estimation step failed during createCharPerson() — the character itself was still created with default statistics.

fields.name: failedExtractions
fields.description: Raw LLM scene/character extraction JSON that failed to parse, one JSON-encoded {context,error,rawResponse,failedAt} blob per failure — captured so the raw response can be inspected and manually corrected/redone instead of being silently discarded.

fields.name: compositionContext
fields.description: Optional book-level composition/art-direction anchor prepended to every scene and landscape prompt. Defaults to blank — real style/composition consistency comes from the common sdConfig's style + bodyStyle/imageSetting/imageAction fields; this is only an optional extra prompt-level reinforcement, never auto-seeded from a hardcoded line.

fields.name: sdConfig
fields.description: The book's COMMON image config (style + composition + generation params). Set once per book; read back as the base for every scene's generation (portraits/landscape/scene), with optional per-scene overrides merged on top.

fields.name: compositeSdConfig
fields.description: Optional alternate config for the composite/Kontext step only; falls back to the common sdConfig when absent.

fields.name: characterStyles
fields.description: Optional per-character LOCAL style overrides. Each entry styles ONLY that character's pipeline-rendered portrait (by charPerson objectId); the composite, landscape, and all other characters stay on the common sdConfig. Distinct from the UI reimage per-character portrait config (reimage.js '<name>-SD.json').
